title: Read the source policy

title: Read "Unknown License Guard"
reading_goal: Understand the "guard" feature, which automatically holds up materials with unclear licensing status.

choices: To set aside materials whose terms of use are unclear rather than using them immediately

explanation: Since it’s difficult to remove material later once it’s been included, it’s safer to set it aside at the outset. The “unknown license guard” is a guideline designed to prevent the careless use of material with an unclear license. It’s safest to exclude such material from publication or redistribution until its source has been verified.
